blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables efficient streaming synthesis, but errors introduced in early temporal blocks are reused as context and can propagate through subsequent rollouts, leading to detail degradation, structural drift, and unstable motion. Existing distribution matching distillation (DMD) primarily aligns student and teacher distributions in diffusion latent space, but provides no direct supervision over the perceptual quality of decoded videos. We introduce Radian , a representation-space adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data adversarial supervision in the feature space defined by a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, Radian sparsely decodes frames from autoregressive student rollouts, extracts multi-level visual representations, and applies lightweight discriminator heads to distinguish generated outputs from real video frames. The DMD objective anchors the student to the pretrained teacher, while the representation-space adversarial objective supplies complementary perceptual and semantic gradients that promote high-quality modes. These additional components are discarded after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference-time denoising budget unchanged. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B cover four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and minute-long autoregressive generation. Our method achieves a VBench Total of 0.8444 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 0.8033 under four-step generation, and improves VBench-Long from 0.7805 0.7805 to 0.8041 0.8041 over Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. Controlled comparisons across image, video, and diffusion representations further indicate that the choice of representation spaces induces distinct adversarial signals, and external VFM gradients complement DMD more effectively than adversarial supervision derived from diffusion-internal features. Project page: https://rslinfy.github.io/Radian-Project-Page .
blocks.zh: 很少步骤的自动回流视频生成可以实现高效的流体合成,但早期时间块中引入的误差作为上下文被重复使用,并且可以通过随后的推出来传播,导致细节降解,结构漂移,以及不稳定的运动. 现有的分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)主要在扩散潜伏空间对学生和教师的分布进行配对,但对解码视频的认知质量没有直接监督. 我们介绍Radian, 一个代表空间对抗蒸馏框架, 在训练期间,拉迪安稀疏地将帧从自动后退的学生推出中解码,提取多层次的视觉表现,并应用轻量级的歧义头来区分产生的输出与真实的视频帧. DMD目标将学生固定在预训教师的身边,而表现空间对抗目标则提供互补的知觉和语义梯度,促进高质量的模式. 这些额外构成部分在培训后被放弃,使发电机结构和推论时间取消预算不变。 Wan2.1-1.3B上的实验涵盖四步方向的分块式,单步框式,以及短长的自递式生成. 我们的方法在四步生成中实现了V Bench总计0.84440.8444和VideoAlign总计0.80330.8033,并将V Bench-Long从0.78050.7805提高到0.80410.8041,同时使用较少的调试步骤. 对图像、视频和传播表现方式进行有控制的比较,进一步表明,代表空间的选择诱发截然不同的对抗信号,外部VFM梯度比传播-内部特征产生的对抗性监督更有效地补充DMD。 项目网页:https://rslinfy.github.io/Radian-Project-Page。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent video generation models have substantially advanced visual fidelity, motion realism, and prompt alignment ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Wiedemer et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2025 ; Seedance & et al., 2026 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ) . However, typical video generators synthesize fixed-length clips through bidirectional temporal attention, incurring prohibitive latency, computational costs and incompatibility with causal streaming generation. These limitations conflict with today’s urgent demand for interactive world models, real-time audio-visual avatars, 3D telepresence, and online video editing, which require continuous generation and immediate response ( Zhao et al., 2026c ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . The central challenge is to retain the quality of a bidirectional teacher under a small sampling budget and long autoregressive rollouts.
blocks.zh: 近期的视频生成模型具有相当高的视觉忠诚度,运动现实性,以及即时对齐性(Wan等人,2025年;Wiedemer等人,2025年;Kong等人,2025年;Seedance等人,2026年;HaCohen等人,2026年). 然而,典型的视频生成器通过双向时间注意来合成固定长度的剪辑,产生惊人的延时性,计算成本以及与因果流传生成不兼容. 这些限制与当今对交互式世界模型、实时视听动画、3D远程直播和在线视频编辑的迫切需要相冲突,这需要不断生成和立即作出反应(Zhao等人,2026c; Sun等人,2025年;Huang等人,2000年。 2025b; Zhu等人, 2026b; Lin等人, 2026). 中心挑战是在少量抽样预算和长期自动推出的情况下保持双向教师的质量。

blocks.en: Most previous works address the first challenge through few-step diffusion distillation. Progressive and consistency-based methods compress iterative denoising by direct mappings between noise levels ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Lu & Song, 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026c ) , while Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a student to reproduce the output distribution of a pretrained diffusion teacher ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . Recent video generation methods like Self Forcing further combine distillation with block-wise causal generation and KV caching, and train the student on its own generated histories to reduce the train-test gap ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, early generated blocks with errors become the context for subsequent blocks, and these errors then propagate and accumulate over generation, leading to visual degradation, detail loss, and semantic drift. Moreover, methods like DMD transfer the teacher distribution through score differences in the diffusion latent space, failing to align decoded outputs with real videos.
blocks.zh: 之前的大多数作品都通过少步扩散蒸馏来解决第一个挑战. 渐进式和基于一致性的方法通过直接测绘噪音水平来压缩迭代去诺(Salimans & Ho, 2022年;Song等人, 2023年;Luo等人, 2023年;Lu & Song, 2025年;Zheng等人, 2026年c),而分布匹配稀释(DMD)则训练一名学生以复制经过事先培训的传播教师的产出分布(Yin等人, 2024年b; Yin et al., 2024a ). in. 近期的视频生成方法,如Self Forcing,进一步结合了蒸馏与区块因果生成和KV缓存,对学生进行自身生成的历史培训,以减少列车测试差距(Yin等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年a;Zhu等人,2026年a; Gu等人,2026年;Ge等人,2026b;Liu等人,2026年;Cui等人,2026年). 尽管如此,早期产生的有误差的块成为后续块的上下文,这些误差随后传播并累积成一代,导致视觉退化,细节丢失,语义漂移. 此外,DMD等方法通过传播潜在空间的分数差异转移教师的分布,未能将解码输出与真实的视频对齐.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Complementary Representation-Space Supervision. Radian complements DMD with perceptual gradients, guiding the student toward a better-matched data distribution.
blocks.zh: 图1:辅助性代表-空间监督。 拉迪安用感官梯度来补充DMD,引导学生更好地匹配数据分布.

blocks.en: Another line of works improve few-step generators through adversarial distillation ( Sauer et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . When real samples are used as the positive reference, the discriminator provides a measure of data realism that teacher-based score matching does not offer. ADD exploits this principle for image generation in the representation-space of a frozen DINOv2 encoder ( Sauer et al., 2024b ) . When it comes to video generation, in contrast, discrimination is performed in clean or noise-corrupted VAE latents or internal features from DiT backbones. However, such discrimination may be sub-optimal for improving the video quality, as VAE latents are optimized for compression and reconstruction, whereas diffusion-backbone features are learned for denoising or velocity prediction. The diffusion space used by DMD is close to them, causing adversarial gradients to overlap with score distillation. Moreover, without RGB decoding, the discriminator cannot detect texture blur, artifacts, or VAE decoding errors, making such features suboptimal for adversarial supervision.
blocks.zh: 另一行工程通过对抗蒸馏改进了几步发电机(Sauer等人,2024a); Lin等人,2025a;Lin等人,2025b;Feng等人,2026a;Li等人,2026;Lin等人,2024;Cheng等人,2026). 当真实的样本作为正比参考时,歧视者提供了基于教师的分数比对不提供的数据现实主义的度量. ADD利用这一原则在冷冻的DINOv2编码器的表示空间生成图像(Sauer等人,2024年b). 与此相反,在视频生成方面,歧视是在DiT主干线的清洁或噪音腐蚀VAE潜伏或内部特征中进行的。 然而,这种歧视对于提高视频质量可能不够理想,因为VAE潜伏物被优化用于压缩和重建,而扩散背骨特征则被学习用于去名或速度预测。 DMD所使用的扩散空间接近它们,导致对抗梯度与分数蒸馏重叠. 此外,没有RGB解码,歧视者无法检测到纹理模糊,文物,或VAE解码错误,使得这些特征对对抗性监督不理想.

blocks.en: In this work, we present Radian , a method that performs adversarial distillation in representation space to enhance few-step autoregressive video generation. Radian augments on-policy DMD with an adversarial objective over features from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, selected outputs from causal autoregressive rollouts are decoded into RGB frames and mapped to multi-level VFM features, which are distinguished from those of real videos using lightweight discriminator heads. The VFM and discriminator heads are removed after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference cost unchanged. DMD anchors the student to the teacher distribution, while representation-space adversarial supervision uses real data to suppress perceptually and semantically degraded outputs and reshape the learned distribution toward higher-quality modes.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍Radian, 一种在代表空间中进行对抗式蒸馏的方法, 拉迪安增加了政策DMD,对冷冻视觉基础模型(VFM)的特征设定了对抗目标. 在训练期间,因果自递式推出的选定产出被解码为RGB框架,并映射到多级VFM特性,这些特性与使用轻量级歧义头的真视频不同. VFM及歧视者头部在训练后被移除,使发电机架构和推论成本保持不变. DMD将学生锁定在教师分布上,而表现-空间对抗式监督则使用真实的数据来抑制知觉和积分退化的输出,并重塑学习到的分布,转向更高质量的模式.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. We introduce a new representation adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data supervision over decoded outputs while preserving the original inference architecture and cost. Beyond the proposed framework, we systematically study adversarial representation spaces spanning image VFMs including DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) , DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , and SigLIP2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , video encoders including V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) and VideoMAE ( Tong et al., 2022 ) , as well as diffusion-internal features. Our analysis further shows that different image representations induce distinct adversarial signals, video representations provide complementary temporal regularization, and external VFM gradients are more complementary to DMD than diffusion-internal supervision as conceptually illustrated in Fig. 1 . Finally, experiments on causal generators built upon Wan2.1 1.3B demonstrate consistent improvements in visual quality, motion quality, and prompt alignment over strong Forcing-series baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance on VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) and VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ) across 4-step, 1-step, and long-horizon generation.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下。 我们采用了一个新的代表性对抗式提炼框架,通过对解码产出进行实时数据监督,补充政策DMD,同时保留原始推论结构和成本。 在拟议框架之外,我们系统地研究横跨VFM图像的对抗性代表空间,包括DINov2(Oquab等人,2023年),DINov3(Siméoni等人,2025年)和SigLIP2(Tschannn等人,2025年),视频 编码器包括V-JEPA 2.1(Mur-Labadia等人,2026年)和VideoMAE(Tong等人,2022年),以及传播-内部功能。 我们的分析还表明,不同的图像表现会诱发明显的对抗信号,视频表现提供补充时间规范化,外部VFM梯度比图1中的概念显示的传播-内部监督更能补充DMD. 最后,关于因果发电机的实验建立在Wan2.1上。 1.3B在视觉质量,运动质量方面表现出一致的改善,并且迅速比强强的强制序列基线对齐,在V Bench(黄等人,2023年)和V Bench-Long(黄等人,2024年)上实现了最先进的性能,跨越了4步,1步,长距离生成.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Few-Step and Autoregressive Video Generation. Few-step diffusion distillation generally follows trajectory- or distribution-based paradigms.
Trajectory-based methods compress teacher sampling trajectories through progressive or consistency objectives ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Lu & Song, 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026c ; Zheng et al., 2026b ) , whereas distribution-based methods directly align student and teacher output distributions.
DMD estimates a reverse Kullback–Leibler (KL) gradient from teacher and student score functions, and DMD2 further improves score estimation and training stability ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Ge et al., 2025 ) .
Related variants further adapt distribution matching to efficient few-step video generation ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026b ) .
For streaming generation, autoregressive video models factorize videos into causal temporal blocks and reuse previous outputs through KV caching.
CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) distills bidirectional video diffusion into a few-step causal generator, while Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) reduces the training–inference gap by training on the student’s own rollouts.
Causal Forcing and Causal Forcing++ further improve initialization and scalable few-step frame-wise generation ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026d ) , while Rolling Forcing and Self Forcing++ extend self-rollout training to long-horizon generation ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) .
Recent works further explore complementary mechanisms for long-horizon streaming generation: Salt++ aligns causal contexts across generator sampling and score estimation for few-step multimodal generation ( Ge et al., 2026a ) , while Spatia maintains an updatable 3D memory to improve long-term spatial consistency ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
少步与自动回转视频生成. 很少步骤的传播蒸馏一般遵循以轨迹或分布为基础的范式。
基于轨迹的方法通过进步或一致性目标压缩教师采样轨迹(Salimans & Ho, 2022;Song等人, 2023;Luo等人, 2023;Lu & Song, 2025;Zheng等人, 2026c;Zheng等人, 2026b),而基于分配的方法直接将学生和教师产出分配一致.
DMD从师生分数函数中估算出一个反向Kullback-Leibler(KL)梯度,DMD2进一步提高了分数估计和培训稳定性(Yin等人,2024b; Yin等人,2024a;Ge等人,2025年).
相关变体进一步适应高效的几步视频生成(Gu等人,2026年;Ge等人,2026年b).
对于流体生成,自旋式视频模型将视频因素化为因果时间块,并通过KV缓存重用以前的输出.
CausVid(Yin等人,2025年)将双向视频传播分解成几步因果生成器,而Self Forcing(Huang等人,2025年a)则通过对学生自身推出的培训来缩小培训-推论差距.
Causal Forcing and Causal Forcing ++ 进一步改进初始化和可缩放的几步帧式生成(Zhu等人,2026a); Zhao et al., 2026d ),而Rolling Forcing和Self Forcing++则将自我推出训练扩展到长视一代(Liu et al., 2026; Cui et al., 2026).
最近的工作进一步探索了长视流层生成的补充机制: Salt++在生成器取样和分数估算之间,对几步多模式生成(Ge等人,2026年a)进行因果结合,而Spatia则保持可更新的3D内存,以提高长期空间一致性(Zhao等人,2026年b).

blocks.en: Adversarial Training for Diffusion Models. Adversarial objectives have been widely used to preserve sample quality under small inference budgets. In image generation, ADD combines diffusion score distillation with a discriminator on frozen DINOv2 features ( Sauer et al., 2024b ) , while related methods also exploit internal diffusion representations ( Sauer et al., 2024a ) . Extending to video generation, APT applies adversarial post-training to one-step synthesis ( Lin et al., 2025a ) , and AAPT further adapts it to autoregressive video generation ( Lin et al., 2025b ) . Subsequent work explores adversarial distribution matching, cross-step self-distillation, phased training, and other autoregressive adversarial formulations ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, most existing methods discriminate with diffusion-internal features, which may provide redundant or conflicting supervision with DMD and remain weakly aligned with decoded videos, limiting sensitivity to pixel-space artifacts.
blocks.zh: 传播模式的横向培训。 在小的推论预算下,横向目标被广泛用于保持样本质量. 在图像生成中,ADD将扩散分数蒸馏与冷冻的DINOv2特性(Sauer等人,2024年b)的区分剂结合起来,而相关方法也利用了内部扩散表达(Sauer等人,2024年a). 延伸至视频生成,APT将对抗性后训练应用于单步合成(Lin等人,2025a),APT进一步使其适应自动视频生成(Lin等人,2025b). 。 。 。 随后的工作探索了对抗性分配配比,跨步自沉,分阶段训练,以及其他自旋性对抗性配方(吕等,2025年;杨等,2026年;程等,2026年;李等,2026年;冯等,2026年a;罗等,2026年). 尽管如此,大多数现有方法都带有扩散-内部特性,这些特性可能与DMD提供冗余或相互冲突的监督,并且仍然与解码视频保持微弱的配合,限制了对像素空间文物的敏感性.

blocks.en: Pretrained Representations for Generative Modeling. Pretrained representation spaces are increasingly used in generative modeling ( Oquab et al., 2023 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2023 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) aligns intermediate DiT states with clean VFM features, while RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026a ) adopts frozen VFM encoders as generative latent spaces. Subsequent works further explore structured representations and representation-space generative supervision ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Feng et al., 2026b ) . In contrast, our proposed method targets an already distilled autoregressive generator and adversarially distinguishes decoded real and generated videos using frozen VFM features, rather than aligning features or redesigning the latent space. This provides real-data supervision complementary to DMD without additional inference cost.
blocks.zh: 基因模型的预选说明。 遗传模型中越来越多地使用受精的表示空间(Oquab等人,2023年;Siméoni等人,2025年;Asran等人,2023年;Mur-Labadia等人,2026年;Tong等人,2022年;Wang等人,2026年)。 REPA(Yu等人,2024年)使中间的DiT状态具有干净的VFM特征,而RAE(Zheng等人,2026a)采用冷冻VFM编码器作为基因潜伏空间. 随后的作品进一步探索了结构化的表达和表达空间基因监督(Shi等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年a;Feng等人,2026年b). 相比之下,我们提出的方法针对的是已经蒸馏的自递式生成器,对抗式区分了使用冷冻VFM特性解码真实和生成的视频,而不是调整特性或重新设计潜在空间。 这提供真实数据监督,补充DMD,不增加推论费用.

blocks.en: In practice, sparse decoding reduces the activation memory for the frozen VAE and VFM. Generated rollouts are decoded without gradients during discriminator updates, while generator updates retain gradients only through latent neighborhoods. Activation checkpointing and stochastic spatial augmentation reduce memory and discourage reliance on fixed local statistics. Since the VAE decoder, VFM, and discriminator heads are training-only, the supervision adds no inference cost.

blocks.en: We evaluate our method across three autoregressive T2V settings: four-step (4-NFE) chunk-wise short-video generation, its long-horizon extension to one-minute videos, and one-step (1-NFE) frame-wise short-video generation.

blocks.en: Baselines. For four-step chunk-wise generation, we compare our method with Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, and Salt ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Ge et al., 2026b ) . We additionally include a locally implemented DiT-GAN that performs adversarial distillation over internal diffusion features, enabling a controlled comparison between different-based and VFM-based adversarial feature spaces. For one-step frame-wise generation, we compare against Causal Forcing++ and One-Forcing ( Zhao et al., 2026d ; Feng et al., 2026a ) , where One-Forcing is the baseline for DiT-GAN under 1-NFE settings. For long-video generation, we compare against Rolling Forcing ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and extend the generation results to one minute. For the baselines mentioned above, we re-evaluate the released checkpoints under our local environment.

blocks.en: 60-Second Long-Video Generation. Tab. 1(c) ( 1(c) ) reports VBench-Long results for 957-frame videos of approximately one minute. Radian also establishes a new state of the art, achieving a VBench-Long Total of 0.8041 0.8041 , a VBench-Long Quality Score of 0.8511 0.8511 , a Dynamic Degree of 0.6741 0.6741 , and an Imaging Quality score of 0.7194 0.7194 . It significantly outperforms Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. As shown in Fig. 5 and Fig. 8 , our method can better preserve visual details and coherent dynamics over long autoregressive rollouts of 60 seconds, whereas the baseline exhibits accumulated degradation or conservative motion. By adversarially suppressing low-quality feature modes at each autoregressive step, it reduces the local errors propagated through subsequent conditioning contexts, thereby limiting long-horizon error accumulation and improving temporal continuity. blocks.en: Image Representation Feature Spaces. As shown in Tab. 2 , the three image VFMs induce adversarial gradients with different magnitudes and directions, leading to different optimization strengths under the same objective. DINOv2-S provides a moderate and stable signal, achieving the best overall balance with a VBench Total of 0.8444 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 0.8033 . DINOv3-S produces larger gradients and achieves the highest MQ score of 0.2937 0.2937 , although its aggressive updates are harder to stabilize. SigLIP2 instead provides a more semantics-oriented signal, achieving the highest Overall Consistency score of 0.2680 0.2680 while being less sensitive to fine-grained rendering and motion artifacts. These differences arise from each encoder’s feature scale, token geometry, and input Jacobian; thus, identical discriminator learning rates and adversarial weights do not imply equal supervision strength and require separate calibration.

DINOv3-S产生更大的梯度,并达到最高的MQ得分0.29370.2937,尽管其侵略性的更新更难稳定. 而SigLIP2则提供了更注重语义的信号,实现了0.26800.2680的最高总体一致性分,同时对精细的渲染和运动文物不太敏感. 这些差异产生于每个编码器的特征尺度、符号几何和输入的雅各比亚;因此,相同的歧视者学习率和对抗性加权并不意味着监督力相等,需要单独校准。

blocks.en: Temporally Structured Video Features. Video VFMs encode cross-frame dependencies and tend to regularize uncertain temporal changes, improving consistency partly by reducing motion amplitude. As shown in Tab. 2 , V-JEPA 2.1 achieves the highest TA score of 0.4119 0.4119 while its Dynamic score drops to 0.5991 0.5991 , reflecting its preference for predictable and temporally persistent content. VideoMAE preserves richer local semantic and appearance cues, reaching a Semantic score of 0.8115 0.8115 and a Color score of 0.8787 0.8787 , but at the cost of an even lower Dynamic score of 0.5213 0.5213 . Combining DINOv2 with VideoMAE provides a better trade-off between artifact-sensitive spatial supervision and complementary temporal regularization, raising the VBench Total to 0.8434 0.8434 , Dynamic to 0.6593 0.6593 , and Multi-Object to 0.8652 0.8652 . These results suggest that video representations are most effective as complementary temporal priors rather than replacements for DINOv2 supervision.

VideoMAE保留了更丰富的本地语义和外观提示,达到语义分数0.8115 0.8115和彩色分数0.8787,但代价更低的动态分数0.5213 0.5213. 将DINOv2与VideoMAE相结合,在对文物敏感的空间监督与互补的时间规范之间提供了更好的权衡,将V Bench的总比分提高到0.8434 0.8434,动态比分提高到0.6593 0.6593,多对象比分提高到0.8652 0.8652. 这些结果表明,视频表现作为补充时间前科而不是取代DINOv2监督最为有效.

blocks.en:
Complementarity with DMD Gradients. DiT-GAN exhibits different optimization behavior from VFM-based adversarial supervision. As shown in Tab. 2 , it achieves the strongest Semantic score of 0.8122 0.8122 , plausibly because diffusion-teacher features align with latent denoising and retain task-relevant generative semantics. Nevertheless, its VideoAlign profile remains weak: VQ, MQ, and TA are − 0.0242 -0.0242 , 0.0855 0.0855 , and 0.3715 0.3715 , yielding the worst VideoAlign Total of 0.4327 0.4327 . Our gradient-direction analysis suggests that DiT-GAN gradients are strongly coupled with DMD, reinforcing directions already present in the distillation objective. In contrast, gradients from DINO-, SigLIP-, V-JEPA-, and VideoMAE-based discriminators are approximately orthogonal to DMD. This suggests that representation-space adversarial supervision introduces complementary perceptual, semantic, or temporal directions rather than merely strengthening distillation.
More qualitative comparisons are provided in Appendix B.1 .

blocks.en: Ablation on Encoder Size. We examine whether scaling the frozen DINOv2 encoder improves adversarial distillation. As shown in Tab. 3 , larger encoders do not yield monotonic gains, while DINOv2-S/14 provides the best overall balance in VBench and VideoAlign. DINOv2-G/14 reaches 0.8387 0.8387 and 0.3257 0.3257 , respectively, whereas DINOv2-B/14 achieves a higher VideoAlign Total of 0.8910 0.8910 but a lower VBench Total of 0.8322 0.8322 . This is consistent with ADD, where DINOv2 ViT-S also outperforms ViT-L as the discriminator backbone ( Sauer et al., 2024b ) . Larger ViTs may discard local appearance cues through increasingly invariant semantic features, while higher feature dimensionality and discriminator capacity can yield noisier gradients. Thus, a stronger encoder does not necessarily provide a better adversarial feature space.

DINOv2-G/14分别达到0.8387 0.8387和0.3257 0.3257,而DINOv2-B/14则实现了更高的视频对齐总和0.8910 0.8910,但V Bench总和则较低0.8322 0.8322. 这与ADD是一致的,DINov2 ViT-S作为歧视主干也比ViT-L强(Sauer等人,2024年b). 大一点 ViTs可能会通过日益变化无常的语义特征丢弃本地的外观提示,而更高的特征维度和歧视性能力则可以产生鼻音梯度. 因此,一个更强大的编码器不一定提供更好的对抗性特征空间.

blocks.en:
Ablation on Feature Layer Selection. We further ablate the number and positions of DINOv2 layers used by the discriminator. In Tab. 4 , the one-, two-, four-, and eight-layer settings use blocks { 11 } \{11\} , { 6 , 11 } \{6,11\} , { 6 , 8 , 10 , 11 } \{6,8,10,11\} , and { 2 , 4 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 } \{2,4,6,7,8,9,10,11\} , respectively. Specifically, VBench Total increases from 0.8182 0.8182 to 0.8283 0.8283 , peaks at 0.8444 0.8444 with four layers, and drops to 0.8381 0.8381 with eight, indicating diminishing returns. Too few layers provide insufficient multi-level supervision, while too many introduce redundant low-level cues. In particular, the final block overemphasizes invariant semantics and weakens local details, whereas early layers can overemphasize textures. The four layers therefore balance structural, semantic, and local appearance evidence without a high complexity.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced Radian , a representation adversarial distillation framework for few-step autoregressive video generation. While DMD transfers the diffusion teacher’s generative prior in latent space, Radian complements it with real-data adversarial supervision over multi-level features from a frozen visual foundation model, directly improving decoded video quality without additional inference cost. Experiments across short, one-step, or long-horizon generation demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, motion quality, and autoregressive stability. Our analysis further shows that different representation spaces induce distinct optimization signals: image VFMs differ in gradient strength and emphasize different perceptual or semantic cues, while video-native representations provide temporal regularization, often with reduced motion diversity. Moreover, external VFM gradients are largely complementary to DMD, whereas diffusion-internal adversarial features are more strongly coupled with the original distillation objective. These findings highlight representation-space supervision as an effective way to refine few-step autoregressive video generation quality.
blocks.zh: 本文引入了Radian, 虽然DMD在潜伏空间中先转移传播老师的基因,但Radian通过对多层次特征的实数据对抗性监督从冷冻的视觉基础模型中加以补充,直接提高解码视频质量,而无需额外的推论成本. 跨越短,单步,或长视距生成的实验,显示出视觉忠贞性,运动质量,自旋稳定性的改善. 我们的分析进一步表明,不同的表达空间会诱导不同的优化信号:图像VFM在梯度强度上不同,强调不同的感官或语义提示,而视频内涵则提供时间规范化,往往运动多样性降低. 此外,外部的VFM梯度在很大程度上是对DMD的补充,而扩散-内部对抗特征则与最初的蒸馏目标更紧密地结合. 这些调查结果突出表明,代表-空间监督是改进几步自动录像制作质量的有效途径。

blocks.en: Networks and latent geometry. The student is a causal Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . A frozen bidirectional Wan2.1-T2V-14B supplies teacher predictions, and a trainable 1.3B fake-score model estimates the student distribution. The text encoder, VAE, and visual backbone are frozen. blocks.en: A.5 Training Configuration
blocks.zh: A.5 培训配置

blocks.en: Training data. All experiments use the same 40K captioned-video training collection. Real clips are uniformly sampled to 81 frames, resized to 832 × 480 832\times 480 , and represented in [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] for VAE processing. Representation inputs are mapped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] before encoder-specific normalization. Real and generated videos are sampled independently, with image sampling aligned by normalized temporal positions. The DMD and GAN objectives use separate on-policy rollouts.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 所有实验都使用相同的40K字幕视频训练集. 真实片段统一取样为81帧,大小调整为832×480 832\times 480,并用[−1,1][-1,1]表示用于VAE处理. 在编码器特定规范化之前,表示式投入被映射到[0, 1][0, 1]. 真实的和生成的视频是独立采样的,图像采样按照正常的时间位置对齐. DMD和GAN的目标分别使用政策推广.

blocks.en: DMD-only continuation as reference. Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) and Causal Forcing Zhu et al. (2026a) serve as the DMD-based reference models for the two initialization routes. They do not use representation-space adversarial supervision, whereas Radian augments the corresponding causal generator with discriminator calibration followed by joint DMD and representation-adversarial refinement. We therefore use these baselines to assess the effect of introducing representation-space adversarial supervision.
blocks.zh: 仅作为参考的DMD续作. 自强制 (Huang等人,2025a)和Causal Forcing Zhu等人(2026a)是两条初始化路线的基于DMD的参考模型. 它们不使用代表-空间对抗式监督,而拉迪安则通过歧视者校准来增强相应的因果发生器,然后是联合DMD和代表-对抗式改进。 因此,我们利用这些基线来评估引入代表-空间对抗监督的效果。

blocks.en: Stage I: causal ODE initialization. Stage I uses a causal ODE initialization of the pretrained foundation model. The main chunk-wise route uses the Self Forcing initialization ( Huang et al., 2025a ) ; the CD-initialized variant loads causal_cd.pt . These provide alternative starting weights for subsequent Radian post-training.

blocks.en: On-policy DMD. The student generates autoregressive rollouts conditioned on its own history. The frozen teacher and trainable fake-score model process the same diffusion-corrupted student latents, and their prediction difference provides the DMD update direction. The update direction is detached when optimizing the student, while the fake-score model is trained separately with a flow-denoising objective on detached student samples. The DMD and representation-adversarial objectives use separate on-policy rollouts sampled from the same student.
blocks.zh: 政策DMD. 学生产生以自身历史为条件的自动推出. 冷冻的老师和可训练的假分模型处理同样的扩散-腐蚀学生潜伏,他们的预测差异提供了DMD更新方向. 更新方向在优化学生时是脱解的,而假分数模型则在脱解学生样本上以流解目标单独训练. DMD和代表对抗目标使用从同一学生中抽取的单独政策推广。

blocks.en: Batching and hardware. Training follows a five-iteration update cycle: the generator is updated once every five outer iterations, while fake-score and discriminator updates occupy the intervening iterations. The default chunk-wise run uses eight workers, one video per worker, and eight DMD accumulation microbatches, resulting in 64 videos per DMD update. The GAN branch uses one video per worker and eight sampled frames per video, resulting in eight videos per update. Losses are mean-reduced within each branch.
blocks.zh: 打击和硬件。 培训遵循5个输入更新周期:生成器每5个外迭更新一次,而假分和歧义更新则占据中间迭代. 默认的分块运行使用8个工人,每个工人1个视频,以及8个DMD积存微管,结果每DMD更新64个视频. GAN分支每名工人使用1个视频,每部视频使用8个抽样帧,结果每部更新8个视频. 损失在每一分支内平均减少。

blocks.en: All final experiments run on NVIDIA B300 GPUs. The default configuration uses eight GPUs, bfloat16 mixed precision, hybrid FSDP, and activation checkpointing. Checkpointed frozen-encoder and VAE forwards retain input gradients during generator updates.
blocks.zh: 所有最终实验都运行在NVIDIA B300 GPU上. 默认配置使用8个GPU,bfloat16混合精度,混合FSDP,以及激活检查. 被检查的冷冻编码器和VAE前置在生成器更新时保留输入梯度.

blocks.en: Frame-wise post-training. The one-step recipe uses 500 DMD-only iterations followed by 100 iterations of discriminator calibration before joint training. At joint activation, the generator learning rate changes from 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} to 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} ; the discriminator and fake-score learning rates are 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} and 4 × 10 − 7 4\times 10^{-7} , respectively. One DMD microbatch per worker gives an effective batch size of eight videos. The DMD stream uses text prompts, while the adversarial stream uses captions associated with real videos.
blocks.zh: 框架培训后。 单步配方在联合训练前使用500个DMD唯一的迭代,之后使用100个迭代的歧视者校准. 在联合激活时,发电机学习率从2×10−6 2\time 10×6}变为5×10×7 5\time 10×7};歧视者和假得分学习率分别是3×10×6 3\time 10×6和4×10×7 4\time 10×7}. 每个工人一个DMD微批量给出8个视频的有效批量尺寸. DMD流使用文本提示,而对抗流则使用与真实视频相关的字幕.

The median adversarial-to-DMD gradient-norm ratio is 0.8381 \mathbf{0.8381} , showing that the adversarial signal has a comparable magnitude. These loss-weighted, pre-clipping measurements support directional complementarity in the examined run, although they do not establish universal orthogonality across representation backbones or, by themselves, demonstrate improved optimization.
blocks.zh: 辅助渐渐. 在基于VideoMAE的辅助运行中,超过127个生成器更新的测量结果得出GAN–DMD梯度共比值为−0.0234±0.0534\ mathbf{-00234\pm 0.0534}(平均值±\pm标准偏差),表示本诊断中平均大约正向方向. 对抗-DMD梯度-规范的中位数比为0.8381\mathbf{0.8381},表明对抗信号具有相当的强度. 这些损失加权、预分测量支持了所检查运行中的方向互补性,尽管它们没有确立代表性主干线的通用正交率,或者本身就显示出更好的优化。

blocks.en: Image-encoder adaptations. DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) uses bilinear resizing and ImageNet normalization; SigLIP2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) uses bicubic resizing and channel mean/standard deviation 0.5. Both use normalized features and a final patch-mean readout in place of the default CLS readout. Selected intermediate features receive affine-free LayerNorm. SigLIP2’s final output retains its pretrained post-normalization, and its 768-channel tokens are projected to 512 channels before discrimination. DINOv3 uses 384-channel heads without the default local normalization. The image feature heads preserve spatial tokens instead of reducing each frame to a single classification embedding. Table 8 summarizes the feature and head designs. Since input geometry and head adaptations vary across model families, these experiments evaluate the resulting representation-supervision configurations as complete design choices.
blocks.zh: 图像编码器改造. DINOv3(Siméoni等人,2025年)使用双线重定大小和ImageNet正常化;SigLIP2(Tschannn等人,2025年)使用双线重定大小和信道平均/标准偏差0.5. 两者都使用常态特性和最终补丁-平均值读出来代替默认的CLS读出. 所选中间特性获得无丝状层 Norm. SigLIP2的最终产出保留了经过预先训练的正常化后,其768个频道的信号预测在歧视前将达到512个渠道。 DINOv3使用384通道头,没有默认本地正常化. 图像特征头部保存空间符,而不是将每个框缩小为单一的分类嵌入. 表8总结了特征和头部设计. 由于输入几何和头部适应因模型家族而异,这些实验评价了由此产生的表现-超视觉配置作为完整的设计选择.

blocks.en: Video and mixed representations. V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) and VideoMAE ( Tong et al., 2022 ) use 32-frame clips at RGB stride two, spanning 63 source positions. Resizing preserves aspect ratio with short side 256 and dimensions divisible by 16 ( 448 × 256 448\times 256 without cropping). A sampled spatial crop is shared across the clip, and both models use ImageNet normalization. Generated clips are decoded in overlapping four-latent pieces with overlap two.

blocks.en: Video-only variants use five projected spatiotemporal heads. The mixed DINOv2+VideoMAE configuration supplements the image heads with a final-layer video branch consisting of spatial pooling within each tubelet, a 768 → 512 768\rightarrow 512 projection, and temporal convolutions that produce scalar logits. Separate heads and optimizers preserve the distinct token organizations of the image and video branches.
blocks.zh: 唯视频变体使用五个预测的spatiopal头. 混合的DINOv2+VideoMAE配置以一个由每个管内空间集合组成的终层视频分支,一个768 → 512 768\右旋512投影,以及产生刻度对数的时间演化来补充图像头. 单独的头部和优化器保留了图像和视频分支的显著标志性组织.

blocks.en: The video-only discriminator retains dense spatiotemporal tokens, whereas the auxiliary temporal branch in the mixed configuration pools spatial locations before temporal discrimination. Image encoders process sampled frames independently, while video encoders capture cross-frame variation within the sampled clip. The two branches therefore provide complementary spatial and temporal feature structures.
blocks.zh: 仅限视频的歧视者保留了密集的spatiotemporal标志,而混合组合中的辅助时间分支在时间歧视之前就集合了空间位置。 图像编码器独立处理采样帧,而视频编码器则在采样剪辑中捕捉跨帧变异. 因此,这两个分支提供了互补的空间和时间特征结构。

blocks.en: Diffusion-internal representation. DiT-GAN replaces the external VFM with frozen teacher features. Real and generated latents receive a shared diffusion timestep and noise realization, with null text conditioning used for feature extraction. Projected features are passed to local and video-pooled heads. Generator updates differentiate through the frozen feature model, while discriminator updates use detached latents.

blocks.en: B.1 Additional Qualitative Comparisons
blocks.zh: B.1 其他定性比较

blocks.en: We provide additional qualitative comparisons across generation regimes and discriminator configurations, complementing the quantitative results in the main text. The cases cover human activities, stylized scenes, animals, and object interactions, including several detailed prompts that specify both appearance and action. Each 5-second case shows three frames at 0 0 , 2.5 2.5 , and 5 5 seconds, while each long-video case shows six frames spanning approximately one minute. Prompts and displayed times are shared across methods within each case.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了代际制度和歧视性结构之间的更多质量比较,补充了正文中的量化结果。 这些案件涉及人类活动,定型场景,动物,以及物体的相互作用,包括几个详细提示,既说明外表,也说明动作. 每5秒的病例显示3帧0,2.52.5,5秒,而每长视频显示6帧大约1分钟. 提示和显示时间在每种情况下采用不同的方法。

blocks.en: Short-video generation. Figures 6 and 7 compare Radian with Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) and Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) under four-step chunk-wise generation, and with Causal Forcing++ ( Zhao et al., 2026d ) and One Forcing ( Feng et al., 2026a ) under one-step frame-wise generation. In the four-step examples, Radian maintains recognizable faces and keeps the telephone receiver or the pianist’s hands and keyboard visible across the sampled frames. In the one-step examples, the Causal Forcing++ piano sample does not clearly show the requested keyboard interaction, while One Forcing exhibits larger changes in the apparent scale of the campfire and surrounding trees. Radian retains the piano-playing composition and the broader snowy scene. These observations complement the main-text results on the value of decoded-output supervision for preserving visual structure under few-step generation.
blocks.zh: 短视一代. 图6和图7将Radian和Self Forcing(黄等人,2025年a)和Causal Forcing(朱等人,2026年a)在四步分明的一代中进行比较,并与Causal Forcing++进行比较 (赵某1等人,2026d)和一甲(冯某1等人,2026a)在单步帧式的一代. 在四个步骤的例子中,拉迪安保持可识别的面孔,并保持电话接收器或钢琴家的手和键盘在抽样帧上可见. 在单步实例中,Causal Forcing++钢琴样片没有明确显示所请求的键盘交互,而One Forcing则显示出营火和周围树木的明显规模的较大变化. 拉迪安保留了钢琴演奏成分和更广泛的雪景. 这些观测结果补充了关于在几步生成下保存视觉结构的解码输出监督值的主要文本结果。

blocks.en: Long-video generation. Figure 8 compares Radian with Rolling Forcing ( Liu et al., 2026 ) on four approximately 60-second videos. In the surfing and telephone examples, Rolling Forcing shows larger subject displacements and partial cropping at several sampled times. Radian keeps the panda and surfboard recognizable and retains a clearer view of the person holding the telephone throughout the displayed sequence. The cafe and European-town examples further show changes in viewpoint while preserving identifiable people, objects, and scene context. These examples are consistent with the main-text long-video results, illustrating how the benefits of representation-space supervision can persist beyond the short generation horizon.
blocks.zh: 长影一代. 图8将Radian和Rolling Forcing(Liu等人,2026年)在四部约60秒的视频中进行比较. 在冲浪和电话例子中,滚动堡垒显示在几个抽样时间出现更大的主题迁移和部分收成. Radian保留了熊猫和冲浪板的识别功能,并保留了整个显示序列中持有电话的人的更清晰的视野. 咖啡馆和欧洲城镇的例子进一步显示观点的变化,同时保护可识别的人、物品和场景背景。 这些例子与主文长视频结果一致,说明了代表性-空间监督的好处如何在短代人范围之外继续存在。

blocks.en: Discriminator ablations. Figures 9 – 11 visualize the feature-space, encoder-size, and feature-layer configurations studied in our ablations. The feature-space examples reveal distinct appearance preferences: VideoMAE follows the black-and-white instruction more closely in the corgi scene, while DINOv2-S retains some color. The coffee, pastry, and lighthouse cases also show differences in object interaction, surface detail, and framing. In the encoder-size examples, the S configuration makes the liquid color transition more apparent, whereas increasing encoder size does not consistently improve the depicted action. The four-layer configuration also combines recognizable structure with local detail in the corgi and astronaut examples. Together, these visualizations complement the quantitative finding that feature suitability matters more than encoder capacity alone, supporting our compact, multi-level DINOv2-S configuration.
blocks.zh: 歧视者煽动。 图9 – 11可视化地物空间,编码器大小,以及我们所研究的地物层配置. 特征-空格实例显示出明显的外观偏好:VideoMAE在corgi场景中更紧密地遵循黑白指示,而DINov2-S则保留一些颜色. 咖啡、糕点和灯塔案例也显示出物体相互作用、表面细节和框架方面的差异。 在编码器大小的例子中,S配置使得液体颜色过渡更加明显,而增加编码器大小并不能持续改善所描绘的动作. 四层配置还结合了可识别的结构与corgi和宇航员实例中的局部细节. 这些可视化加在一起补充了定量的发现,其特征是适合性比仅仅编码能力更重要,支持我们的紧凑,多层次的DINOv2-S配置.

Each case places Rolling Forcing above Radian and its prompt below. Six frames span each 957-frame sequence; the shared time labels are rounded to the nearest second.
blocks.zh: 图8:额外长视频比较。 从上到下:咖啡馆中的咖啡,熊猫冲浪,欧洲小镇的饮用水,雪地的电话交谈. 每一个案件都把 " 滚动堡垒 " 置于拉迪安上空,其 " 快速堡垒 " 置于下方。 六帧每957帧序列横跨;共享的时间标签四舍五入到最近的秒.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Feature-space comparisons. Rows show DINOv2-S, DINOv3, SigLIP2, V-JEPA 2.1, VideoMAE, DINOv2 with VideoMAE, and DiT-GAN. The four cases depict a black-and-white corgi scene, a panda drinking coffee, glazing croissants, and a coastal lighthouse.
blocks.zh: 图9:地物-空间比较。 列显示DINov2-S,DINov3,SigLIP2,V-JEPA 2.1,VideoMAE,DINov2与VideoMAE,DIT-GAN. 这4个案例描绘了一个黑白的corgi场景,一只熊猫喝咖啡,闪闪发光的鳄鱼,以及一个沿海灯塔.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Encoder-size comparisons. DINOv2-S, B, and G are shown on a wolf beside a frozen stream, fireworks viewed from a bridge, a traditional waterwheel, and mixing colored liquids. Each case displays three frames with its prompt below.
blocks.zh: 图10:编码器大小比较。 DINov2-S,B,和G显示在冰冻的溪流旁的狼身上,烟花从桥梁,传统水轮上看到,混合着色液体. 每个案件显示三个框架,其提示如下。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Feature-layer comparisons. Rows use one, two, four, and eight DINOv2-S feature layers, respectively. The cases show a corgi in a park, an astronaut, a train on tracks, and clownfish among coral; Radian uses the four-layer configuration.
blocks.zh: 图11:地物层比较. 行分别使用1,2,4和8个DINov2-S特征层. 案例显示一个公园里有一个科吉,一个宇航员,一个轨道上的火车,以及珊瑚中的小丑鱼;拉迪安使用四层的配置.
